items.title: File Einspruch against the advance-payment assessment
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 22.12.2025. Under §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a posted tax letter counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 26.12.2025 (Friday). That day is Zweiter Weihnachtstag, a public holiday in NW, so under §108 Abs. 3 AO the deemed delivery moves to the next working day, Mon 29.12.2025. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB / §108 Abs. 1 AO the one-month objection period (§355 AO) starts the following day, and under §188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on the day with the same number: Thu 29.01.2026. That day is a normal working day, so no further shift applies.
